description: Configuration for the Weekly Customer Effort Tracker skill. Edit this file to customise customer inference, email filtering, and effort estimation.

customer_aliases.comment: Map name variations to a single canonical customer name. Key = variant, Value = canonical name.

known_customers.comment: Add your active customers here. The tracker uses these to improve inference from meeting titles and email domains.
known_customers.name: Example Customer A

effort_estimation.comment: Controls prep time added to calendar meetings.
